assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: original hero photograph for a fictional luxury-jewelry agency starter website. Create one landscape 1536x1024 editorial product image, not a website screenshot. Subject: one original sculptural open gold cuff with a softly folded organic surface, unbranded and not referencing any existing jewelry design. It rests on a low irregular pale limestone block against warm ivory studio surroundings. Frame the cuff as the large focal object on the right two-thirds; leave quiet warm space on the left for separately rendered website text. Lighting: directional late-afternoon studio light, precise soft-edged shadows, rich but believable gold reflections and fine material detail. Restrained, tactile, premium still-life photography. No flowers, logos, words, watermarks, extra jewelry, people or collage. This is fictional concept imagery and will be labeled as such outside the image.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original landscape hero photograph for a fictional landscaping/design-build agency starter website. Use the scene itself across the full frame; main garden path and tree in the central-right portion so the image can crop vertically.
